test_title: PYST 40: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 1st November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Find the compound interest (correct to decimal places) on Rs. 9,500 in 2 years at 8% per annum, the interest being compounded half-yearly.
solution:
Given:

Rate of interest = 8% p.a. 

Principal = Rs. 9500

Time = 2 years

Concept used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

12 months = 1 y
